vendor: ECHO INTERNATIONAL HK LIMITED (operating as Tensor.Art)
product_family: Consumer-facing AI image/video generation and Stable-Diffusion-family model hosting platform (tensor.art): free credit-based generation, community model marketplace (Checkpoint/LoRA/LyCORIS), templated "AI Tools" workflows (OC Creator, Anime Lab, Photoreal Studio, Smart Edit, etc.), "Forge" custom LoRA/model training, and paid VIP membership tiers (1-day/30-day/90-day credit passes). No distinct enterprise, team, or API product tier was found documented on the vendor's own site.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1/2)
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of SOC 2 anywhere on Tensor.Art's Privacy Policy or Terms of Service, and no trust/security page exists on tensor.art. A third-party badge-aggregator site (Nudge Security) lists 'SOC 2' for Tensor.Art, but this is not corroborated by any vendor-domain page and conflicts with the vendor's own policies, which make no such claim -> treated as unverified, not vendor-asserted.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of ISO 27001 on tensor.art's Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, or any discoverable page. Third-party aggregator claim (Nudge Security) is unverified and not vendor-asserted.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of HIPAA; product is a general-purpose consumer image generator with no health-data use case described. No vendor-domain evidence found.

certifications.name: GDPR (compliance claim)
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy Policy (last updated Oct 12, 2023) does not reference GDPR, EU data-subject rights, a lawful-basis framework, an EU representative, or a Data Processing Agreement. Operator is Hong Kong-based (ECHO INTERNATIONAL HK LIMITED) with no stated EU entity or EU-specific process, despite an apparently global user base.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of PCI DSS in the Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, or VIP Membership terms, despite the platform processing paid subscriptions.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 / 27018 / 27701
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on any tensor.art page.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management system)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on any tensor.art page; no AI-governance certification referenced.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on tensor.art. A third-party aggregator (Nudge Security) lists 'CSA Star Level 1' but this is unverified and not corroborated by the vendor's own site.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: Not applicable / no public evidence; this is a consumer product with no stated US-government customer base. A third-party aggregator lists 'FedRamp' but this is unverified and not vendor-asserted.

privacy.ai_training_note: Privacy Policy states user activity, uploaded images, and generated-content data are used for 'providing, customizing, and improving' the service, 'measurement, analytics,' and 'conducting research and innovation for social good purposes' - vague language that could encompass model/feature improvement but is never stated explicitly. Separately, the policy references 'data you provide when using our Model Training features,' which appears to describe user-initiated custom LoRA/model training on their own uploads (a product feature), not a statement that Tensor.Art trains its own foundation models on all user content. No opt-out mechanism for any training use is described anywhere on the site.
privacy.data_region: Not disclosed. No data-center region, residency, or cross-border-transfer commitments stated in the Privacy Policy. Operating entity is Hong Kong-based (ECHO INTERNATIONAL HK LIMITED, RM 1903, 19/F Lee Garden One, 33 Hysan Avenue, Causeway Bay, HK).

security.name: Encryption in transit / at rest
security.value: Not disclosed. Policy states only generic 'physical, electronic, and managerial procedures' to safeguard data; no specifics on TLS or at-rest encryption.

security.name: Data retention
security.value: Internally inconsistent: policy states data is 'officially' retained for up to 60 days, but adds that 'in practice, we may store data for a longer period' for unspecified 'annual reporting purposes,' with no fixed maximum stated.

security.name: Third-party data sharing
security.value: Vendor states it will 'never sell' user information, but shares data with content-safety review vendors, risk-control/anti-fraud vendors, advertising partners, and affiliated companies under various conditions described in the policy.

security.name: Minimum account age
security.value: Users must be 18 years or older to create an account, per Terms of Service.

security.name: Vulnerability disclosure / bug bounty
security.value: No dedicated security page, vulnerability-disclosure policy, or bug bounty program was found on tensor.art via direct site navigation or search.

products.name: Tensor.Art free tier (web/app)

products.data_scope: Account profile (name, email, settings), generated/uploaded images, activity and interaction metadata, device/browser data

products.data_scope: Same as free tier plus payment/billing information
products.notes: Credit-based paid tiers (e.g. 300 daily credits); no evidence of a separate enterprise/team data-handling or contractual framework.

products.name: Forge / AI Tools / custom model training
products.data_scope: User-uploaded training image sets used to create custom LoRA/checkpoint models that are then published to the platform
products.notes: User-initiated training on the user's own data; no enterprise-grade governance, isolation, or deletion guarantees documented.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium with credit-based VIP subscription tiers (1-day/30-day/90-day passes)
compare.data_residency: unknown / not disclosed (operator headquartered in Hong Kong)

flags: Third-party aggregator site (Nudge Security / security-profiles.nudgesecurity.com) lists SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI, GDPR, FedRAMP, and CSA STAR Level 1 badges for Tensor.Art, but none of these appear anywhere on tensor.art's own Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, or any discoverable trust/security page. This is likely an inaccurate or template-generated third-party listing and should not be used as proof; treat as an unresolved over-claim risk if it has influenced any prior AIFOXX listing for this vendor.
Data retention language is internally inconsistent (states 60 days 'officially' but 'may store data for a longer period' with no cap) - a fairness/transparency concern worth surfacing to buyers.
No explicit statement on whether user content/prompts are used to train Tensor.Art's own models, and no training opt-out described.
No DPA, no EU representative, and no GDPR-specific language despite an apparently global (including EU-reachable) user base.
